kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نجلعد (form IVq)
# نَجْلَعِدُّ (najlaʕiddu) /nad͡ʒ.la.ʕid.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
# نَجْلَعِدَّ (najlaʕidda) /nad͡ʒ.la.ʕid.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
# نَجْلَعِدِّ (najlaʕiddi) /nad͡ʒ.la.ʕid.di/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
